senses.gloss: a pulp of flour mixed with hot water and oil (v.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 89a:6">Men. 89ᵃ</cite> (ref. to Lev. l. c.) <he>יכול יהא חצי … ולר׳</he> lest you think that the half Log of oil is to be equally distributed among the cakes, the wafers, and the pulp; <he>כשהוא אומר בשמן בר׳ ריבה שמן לר׳</he> (Rashi <he>ברְבוּכָה</he>) as the text repeats ‘with oil’ in connection with the pulp, it intimates by the repetition that more oil is required for the pulp.
<cite ref="Tamid 28b:20">Tam. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>להחם חמין לר׳</he> (Ar. <he>לרבוכה</he>) to make hot water for the pulp.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 2:4:10">Y. Pes. II, 29ᵇ</cite> bot.
